scope: Windows launcher: synthetic options replay, no real IBKR or model requests

method.reuse: Repeat start and compare saved PID
method.mode_mismatch: Invoke PS1 on 8028 without -Offline and verify explicit rejection
method.stop: start-options-demo.cmd -Port 8028 -Stop; verify no listening socket or ownership record remains
method.foreign_port: Hold loopback 8029 with a scoped .NET TcpListener, invoke launcher, verify occupied-port rejection and listener remains bound, then dispose listener
method.api: GET scenario and POST run with local engine; inspect source, configuration and provenance only
method.final_cycle: Real Windows PowerShell through CMD: start, reuse, stop on 8028

limits: Browser opening was suppressed by -NoBrowser; this report does not verify page layout.
Cloud and live IBKR behavior are outside this launcher test.
Different machines and nonstandard Python installations were not exhaustively tested.
